verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog states that the mobile app lets users review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent, which matches every element of the story. Related docs confirm that Linear Agent writes code and that diffs render inside Linear, but the mobile line-comment loop rests on a single changelog sentence. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the mobile line-comment-to-agent iteration flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate

citations.quote: Use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent.
Linear Agent can now write code using Claude Code and Codex. You can triage, plan, review, and ship—all in Linear.
